data.long_meaning: In Greek, Frodina is derived from the root words 'Fre' meaning 'God' and 'Din' meaning 'gift'. It symbolizes the divine gift bestowed upon an individual. The name Frodina carries the meaning “God's gift” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Frodina usually hope their child will grow to embody god's gift and live with faith, good character and purpose.
